summary: Frontend-only testing of /pgmei2.html dropdown bug fix. All 6 scenarios passed: dropdown hidden on load (direct access with cache-buster), opens on toggle click, closes on 2nd click, closes on outside click, CNPJ/Nome dynamic for two different CNPJs (37411286000108 -> LUCI SCHIAVI DA SILVA 42017335215; 33648223000119 -> SILVANI GONCALVES MACHADO 26267405869 - different values confirm no hardcoded data), and full flow from home (pgmei.html -> continuar -> pgmei2) arrives with dropdown closed and correct dynamic data. The CSS override '.dropdown-menu{display:none!important}' + '.dropdown.open>.dropdown-menu{display:block!important}' plus JS toggle works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: pgmei2.html is a SingleFile-captured artifact (very large inline CSS/base64 fonts). The CSS override approach works but a cleaner long-term fix would be to re-capture the HTML with the dropdown closed, or strip the embedded '.dropdown-menu{display:block}' from the original rule rather than overriding with !important.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for auto-open dropdown on /pgmei2.html is fully validated. Direct URL load, home-flow navigation, and multiple CNPJs all behave correctly. No remaining issues on this feature.
